plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for H3C wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and wireless clients/radio (enterprise PEN 25506).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the H3C wireless AC control plane (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtCpuUsage), as a 0-100 percentage per physical entity. Most entities return 0 and the CPU-bearing board carries the real value. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy AP or station management load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports memory utilization of the H3C wireless AC (HH3C-ENTITY-EXT-MIB hh3cEntityExtMemUsage, a direct percent value) per physical entity. High memory pressure can affect AP join handling and station roaming.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_connect_count
metrics.description: Current number of APs connected to this H3C wireless AC (HH3C-DOT11-ACMT-MIB hh3cDot11APConnectCount). A sudden drop means APs went offline from the controller.

metrics.name: wlan_station_connect_count
metrics.description: Current number of stations connected through this H3C wireless AC (HH3C-DOT11-ACMT-MIB hh3cDot11StationConnectCount). Sudden drops can indicate RF, authentication, or controller faults.

metrics.name: wlan_max_ap_num_permitted
metrics.description: Maximum AP number permitted on this H3C wireless AC (HH3C-DOT11-ACMT-MIB hh3cDot11MaxAPNumPermitted). This scalar is optional and may be absent on some software versions. Connected AP count approaching this value means the controller is near license or scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_master_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of master APs reported by this H3C wireless AC (HH3C-DOT11-ACMT-MIB hh3cDot11MasterAPCount). Use it with connected AP count to understand fit-AP role mix on the controller.

metrics.name: wlan_total_ap_connected
metrics.description: Total AP connected count reported by this H3C wireless AC (HH3C-DOT11-ACMT-MIB hh3cDot11TotalAPconnected). Compare with the current connected AP count to spot inventory or join-state drift.
